import sys, json, subprocess, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import exact_ref as R, fuzz as F

def core_info(doc):
    ixps=set(doc['ixps']); agg={}
    for rec in doc['rib']:
        p,looped=R.normalize(rec['path'], ixps)
        if looped or len(p)<2: continue
        agg[p]=agg.get(p,0)+rec['count']
    links=set()
    for p in agg:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): links.add(R.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    rounds, finals=R.peel(agg)
    core=sorted(links-set(rounds))
    return core, R.scopes_of(core, R.occurrences(finals, core) if core else [])

def run(name, doc, expect_invalid=False):
    core, scopes = core_info(doc)
    perm = F.find_order(scopes, len(core))
    if perm is None:
        print('SKIP', name); return
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
    doc['order']=[[core[i][0],core[i][1]] for i in perm]
    if expect_invalid:
        expected = {'error':'invalid'}
    else:
        res = R.reference(doc)
        expected = res if 'error' in res else R.floats(res)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    got = json.loads(p.stdout)
    ok = F.same(expected, got)
    print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL ')+name)
    if not ok:
        print(' doc ', json.dumps(doc)[:1200]); print(' want', json.dumps(expected)[:1200]); print(' got ', json.dumps(got)[:1200])

def D(rib, **kw):
    d = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],'queries':[]}
    d.update(kw); return d
def P(p,c): return {'path':p,'count':c}
def Q(i,p,t): return {'id':i,'path':p,'threshold':t}

# two disconnected triangles
run('two-components', D([P([1,2,3],1),P([2,3,1],2),P([3,1,2],3),
                         P([10,20,30],5),P([20,30,10],1),P([30,10,20],2)],
    priors=[{'link':[1,2],'weights':[1,2,3]}],
    declared=[{'link':[30,10],'rel':'p2c'}],
    queries=[Q('a',[1,2,3,1,2],[1,2]),Q('b',[10,20,30,10,20,30],[3,4]),Q('c',[1,10,20],[1,2])]))
# one component of size 1 core link plus bigger component
run('mixed-sizes', D([P([1,2,3],1),P([2,3,1],1),P([3,1,2],1), P([5,6,7,8],2),P([8,5,6,7],1),P([7,8,5,6],3),P([6,7,8,5],1)],
    queries=[Q('a',[5,6,7,8],[1,2]),Q('b',[1,2,3],[1,2]),Q('c',[8,7,6,5],[1,2])]))
# big counts

    queries=[Q('a',[1,2,3],[1,2])]))
# all-peer zero potential endpoint style

# order given but graph wide -> invalid
